# Foldstryx

> Astryx-inspired styling for [Foldkit](https://github.com/Tylian/foldkit), powered by
> [StyleX](https://stylexjs.com). Foldstryx turns Astryx's StyleX-native design tokens and
> component language into named composition primitives so Foldkit apps build
> intent-shaped UI with a token-faithful Astryx look. It sits beside
> [foldstylex](https://github.com/boozedog/foldstylex) (a shadcn-inspired kit) but keeps its
> own visual system and lifecycle.

This is a concise machine-readable index. Start with the
[root README](https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/blob/master/README.md) for the full layer
map and packaging notes.

## Packages

Five external-consumer packages publish together as one coordinated release. Each builds ESM
plus TypeScript declarations to `dist/`. Runtime dependencies live in `dependencies`;
`@foldkit/ui`, `effect`, and `foldkit` are `peerDependencies` where a package imports them
directly, so the host supplies the Foldkit runtime.

- [@foldstryx/tokens](https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/tree/master/packages/tokens) —
  Astryx-faithful design tokens for StyleX. Exposes `colorVars`, `typographyVars`, and other
  token variable groups as StyleX `defineVars` defaults, plus the `index.stylex.ts` module used
  by `@foldstryx/styles`.
  README: https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/blob/master/packages/tokens/README.md

- [@foldstryx/styles](https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/tree/master/packages/styles) —
  Astryx-inspired component and layout styles for StyleX. Ships typed StyleX modules
  (`buttonStyles`, `cardStyles`, `layoutStyles`, …) plus the stable
  `@foldstryx/styles/document.global.css` subpath export with the bundled Atkinson Hyperlegible
  Next / Maple Mono NL NF font assets. The `.stylex.js` modules ship as-is; a consumer's
  `@stylexjs/unplugin` compiles the StyleX CSS at build time.
  README: https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/blob/master/packages/styles/README.md

- [@foldstryx/foldkit](https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/tree/master/packages/foldkit) —
  Named composition primitives (`Button`, `Card`, `Stack`, `Row`, `Text`, `Sidebar`, `Dialog`,
  `Tabs`, …) that pair Foldkit headless behavior with `@foldstryx/styles` visuals.
  README: https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/blob/master/packages/foldkit/README.md

- [@foldstryx/kitchen-sink](https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/tree/master/packages/kitchen-sink) —
  A self-contained, mountable Foldkit submodel kitchen sink. Exposes `Mount` (a
  `Model` / `init` / `update` / `view` submodel; its `Message` is a type-only export) that
  renders the full primitive catalog. This is the regression/catalog mount, distinct from the
  routed docs composition.
  README: https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/blob/master/packages/kitchen-sink/README.md

- [@foldstryx/docs](https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/tree/master/packages/docs) —
  Platform-neutral, routed documentation composition. A Foldkit
  `Model` / `Message` / `init` / `update` / `view` application with typed routes, canonical
  navigation metadata, and a fixed sidebar shell. No browser globals, URL history, Tauri, or
  native APIs — hosts own runtime bootstrap. `@foldstryx/kitchen-sink` is rendered as a
  dedicated docs route rather than making `Mount` itself route-aware.
  README: https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/blob/master/packages/docs/README.md

## Foldkit MVU contract

The interactive packages follow Foldkit's MVU (Model / View / Update) model. A Foldkit
application is defined by:

- `Model` — an Effect `Schema` describing application state.
- `Message` — a typed union of state transitions (also an Effect `Schema` for runtime
  decode/dispatch).
- `init` — the initial state (and commands).
- `update` — a pure `(model, message) => readonly [Model, ReadonlyArray<Command>]` function
  (the next model plus commands to run, branched on `message._tag`).
- `view` — a pure `(model) => Document` function returning `{ title, body }` for Foldkit to
  render.

`@foldstryx/docs` exports these directly, and its `Message` is its runtime Effect Schema.
External hosts can pass that Schema to `Runtime.makeApplication({ devTools: { Message } })` so
the Foldkit DevTools overlay can discover and decode messages without reconstructing the union.
The `Sink.message` payload is intentionally unconstrained (`S.Any`); `HoverNav` / `OpenNav`
ids are JSON-friendly optional-nullable strings (use `null`, not `undefined`, for external
dispatch). The DevTools overlay is host-owned — `@foldstryx/docs` does not depend on
`@foldkit/devtools`.

```ts
import { Runtime } from 'foldkit'
import { Message, Model, init, update, view } from '@foldstryx/docs'
import '@foldstryx/styles/document.global.css'

const application = Runtime.makeApplication({
  Model,
  init,
  update,
  view,
  container: document.getElementById('root'),
  devTools: { Message },
})
Runtime.run(application)
```

## Installation and host bootstrap

Install the packages you consume from npm, plus the Foldkit runtime peers
(`@foldkit/ui`, `effect`, `foldkit`):

```bash
npm install @foldstryx/tokens @foldstryx/styles @foldstryx/foldkit @foldstryx/docs @foldkit/ui effect foldkit
```

Import the global stylesheet and fonts once at host bootstrap:

```ts
import '@foldstryx/styles/document.global.css'
```

StyleX CSS is compiled by the consumer's `@stylexjs/unplugin` at build time (it auto-discovers
packages that depend on `@stylexjs/stylex`). Hosts own runtime bootstrap: container lookup,
DevTools, and URL integration. The browser demo (`examples/sidebar-demo`) is a thin bootstrap
that imports the `@foldstryx/docs` composition and runs it with `Runtime.makeApplication`.

## Platform-neutral boundary and external consumers

The `@foldstryx/docs` composition is platform-neutral — it does not import browser globals,
URL history, Tauri, or native APIs. Hosts supply runtime bootstrap, container lookup,
DevTools, and URL integration. Taurifold is an external desktop consumer of the packages: the
same platform-neutral boundary that `pnpm check:packed` exercises lets a desktop host mount
`@foldstryx/docs` through host-owned runtime wiring (Foldstryx pointer:
[#25](https://github.com/boozedog/foldstryx/issues/25); live work:
[boozedog/taurifold#10](https://github.com/boozedog/taurifold/issues/10)).

Library contracts are distinct from demo/documentation content:

- **Reusable primitives** (`@foldstryx/foldkit`) — named composition helpers for product apps.
- **Kitchen sink** (`@foldstryx/kitchen-sink`) — a mountable regression/catalog submodel.
- **Docs composition** (`@foldstryx/docs`) — the routed documentation application shell.

The external-boundary gate is `pnpm check:packed`, which packs the five packages, installs the
tarballs into a throwaway Vite consumer (no workspace links), and verifies the docs shell, a
route transition, and font loading from package assets.
